signature: SUBROUTINE ZLA_GBAMV( TRANS, M, N, KL, KU, ALPHA, AB, LDAB, X,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANS` specifies the operation to be performed as follows:

| BLAS\_NO\_TRANS | y := $\alpha \, \lvert A \rvert \, \lvert x \rvert + \beta \, \lvert y \rvert$ |
| --- | --- |
| BLAS\_TRANS | y := $\alpha \, \lvert A^T \rvert \, \lvert x \rvert + \beta \, \lvert y \rvert$ |
| BLAS\_CONJ\_TRANS | y := $\alpha \, \lvert A^T \rvert \, \lvert x \rvert + \beta \, \lvert y \rvert$ |

Unchanged on exit.

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of the matrix A. M must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of the matrix A. N must be at least zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: On entry, `ALPHA` specifies the scalar $\alpha$. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: AB
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array `AB` must contain the matrix of coefficients. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: On entry, `LDAB` specifies the first dimension of `AB` as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDAB` must be at least max( 1, m ). Unchanged on exit.

params.name: x
params.reference: and at least ( 1 + ( m - 1 )\*abs( `INCX` ) ) otherwise. Before entry, the incremented array X must contain the vector x. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: incx
params.reference: On entry, `INCX` specifies the increment for the elements of X. `INCX` must not be zero. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: beta
params.reference: On entry, `BETA` specifies the scalar $\beta$. When `BETA` is supplied as zero then Y need not be set on input. Unchanged on exit.

params.name: y
params.reference: and at least ( 1 + ( n - 1 )\*abs( `INCY` ) ) otherwise. Before entry with `BETA` non-zero, the incremented array Y must contain the vector y. On exit, Y is overwritten by the updated vector y. If either m or n is zero, then Y not referenced and the function performs a quick return.

params.name: incy
params.reference:
On entry, `INCY` specifies the increment for the elements of Y. `INCY` must not be zero. Unchanged on exit.

Level 2 Blas routine.

notes: option TRANS is an INTEGER code in the reference; the JS takes the option string
check INFO=6 tests LDAB, not argument 6 (ALPHA): the reference misnumbers it
check INFO=8 tests INCX, not argument 8 (LDAB): the reference misnumbers it
check INFO=11 tests INCY, not argument 11 (BETA): the reference misnumbers it
